zh-Hant.name: 你畫我猜
zh-Hant.summary: 單機自由畫畫、不限時也不計分；線上輪流當畫家，和朋友猜題搶分。
zh-Hant.controls: 畫家用畫筆在畫布作畫，猜題者輸入答案

zh-Hans.name: 你画我猜
zh-Hans.summary: 单机自由画画、不限时也不计分；线上轮流当画家，和朋友猜题抢分。
zh-Hans.controls: 画家用画笔在画布作画，猜题者输入答案

en.name: Draw & Guess
en.summary: Draw freely solo with no timer or scoring, or take turns drawing and guessing with friends online.
en.controls: The artist draws on the canvas; guessers type their answers
